issues: The opening was a grey CONTEXT bar and a grey SUBJECT polygon on a grey stage, so the object being explained was unclear
The whole diagram was drawn on a 480px canvas and scaled up: 10px labels and 64px nodes that were nearly unreadable in the wide shot
After the wipe the mechanism field was light grey with a grey disc and grey button-like nodes: no light, no material, no accent
Once the loop was built everything froze, so the last second felt like a still slide
changes: Custom 'verdigris night' look: teal-tinted near-black with a mint accent (nodes, LEDs, lidar ring) and amber only for diagnostic markers; street scene and mechanism field share one palette and one stage

The opening is now an original delivery robot, Rover 12, driving through a night street (city bokeh, skyline, horizon glow, scrolling lane marks, ground reflection, 44/32px HUD bar); during the wipe the same DOM shrinks into the system centre and its wheels spin down

The diagram is laid out in native 1920×1080 coordinates: dotted blueprint field, a disc with a 96-tick ring, 64px concept labels with the seven-frame flicker, arcs with travelling arrowheads; all card keyframes (62/66/124/127/176/184/208) are kept

Glass nodes are 200px glowing mint glass (radial body, specular ellipse, inner shade, outer glow) that rise 260px with one overshoot and take over the labels with inverted contrast; diagnostics are amber triangles with 32px status text (360° scan / 42 ms plan / Drive OK)
After the loop closes a signal dot circulates along it and the tick ring turns slowly, so the hold still feels like a running system
